en: Color photograph of a large Gothic cathedral with multiple ornate towers and pinnacles, seen from an elevated angle on a bright, clear day. The long nave with flying buttresses and detailed stonework dominates the scene, with a very tall central tower rising above. Small figures walk on the grass and paths around the building, and red-roofed houses and trees surround the cathedral. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
